description: This file defines the abstract class 'AbstractRelationships' which manages metadata about relationship definitions in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for loading, saving, building, and manipulating relationship metadata, as well as utility methods for module and relationship name management.

classes.name: AbstractRelationships
classes.description: An abstract class managing metadata about relationships, providing methods for CRUD operations, building relationship files, and handling relationship definitions within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Finds all deployed modules that can participate in a relationship, optionally including activity modules like Calls and Meetings.

methods.name: validSubpanel
methods.description: Validates if a subpanel layout file exists and contains certain keys.

methods.name: getRelationshipList
methods.description: Returns a list of all non-deleted relationships managed by this instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific relationship object by name.

methods.name: addFromPost
methods.description: Constructs or updates a relationship from $_REQUEST data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship object to the internal set.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads relationships from a PHP file defining an array of relationship objects.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Saves a set of relationships to a PHP file.

methods.name: getDeployedRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves relationships from the database that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for a relationship to avoid conflicts.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds relationship metadata files for the module loader from relationship objects.

methods.name: saveLabels
methods.description: Generates language label PHP files for relationships.

methods.name: saveRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Saves relationship metadata as PHP files for module import.

methods.name: saveSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Saves subpanel layout definitions into PHP files.

methods.name: saveVardefs
methods.description: Generates vardefs PHP files for relationships across modules.

methods.name: parseDeployedModuleName
methods.description: Parses a module's name to determine if it's a deployed or undeployed module, returning relevant info.
